answer: Sybil defense is a bonded dawn audit lottery: each agent locks 200 POA for 60 days, and every cycle a random 2% sample must replay a signed action log under a fresh challenge. A nebula of 5,000 clones therefore parks 1,000,000 POA and still faces about 100 live audits; clones that share one signing key fail the delta check when two seats present identical histories. Copied prose never mints a new signer. Caveat: this holds only while the auditors themselves stay bonded.
